entries.report.title: Settlement report: this node's inference deals
entries.report.summary: What this node's own sealed records show about how its paid inference deals settled, with its deals counted: met, not met, couldn't tell, or did not apply. Every record is checked against the signer keys you trust; a deal whose records do not check out is counted as couldn't tell, not as a failure, and a signer you do not trust is not a sign of tampering.
entries.group.come_through.title: Did the node come through on the terms it accepted?
entries.row.come_through.paid_as_agreed.label: Paid as agreed
entries.row.come_through.paid_as_agreed.detail: When the node bought: every invoice it saw has a settlement its own wallet reported (the node's own report), for the invoice's amount.
entries.row.come_through.paid_as_agreed.not_eval: The node's records do not show enough to say whether it paid as agreed, or a record could not be checked: its signature did not verify, or it was signed by a key you have not chosen to trust, which alone is not a sign of tampering.
entries.row.come_through.paid_as_agreed.reason.c: A record's signature did not verify: it was altered, or it is not what it claims.
Signed by a key outside the keys the report's producer trusted. This alone is not a sign of tampering.
The other side's signed leg failed its signature check: it was altered, or it is not what it claims, so it does not raise the grade.
The other side's signed leg was signed by a key outside the keys the report's producer trusted, so it does not raise the grade. This alone is not a sign of tampering.
entries.row.come_through.served_as_agreed.label: Settlement recorded for every invoice it issued
entries.row.come_through.served_as_agreed.detail: When the node provided: its records show the exchange it accepted terms for, and every invoice it issued has a settlement its wallet reported, for the invoice's amount. This does not show that the answer was good, or that the node's own report of what it ran is true.
entries.row.come_through.served_as_agreed.not_ev: The node's records do not show enough to say whether a settlement was recorded for every invoice it issued, or a record could not be checked: its signature did not verify, or it was signed by a key you have not chosen to trust, which alone is not a sign of tampering.

entries.row.come_through.served_named_model.deta: When a referee decided the deal, this row shows the referee's verdict, read for this node. Otherwise it compares the model its record says was requested with the model its record says answered, which no one else has checked.
